1b1(mdo sna tshogs): @#//rgya gar skad du/Ar+ya b+ha dra ka la bi kA nA ma ma hA yA na sU tra/bod skad du/

1b7(mdo sna tshogs): dge slong 'bum dang yang thabs gcig/byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag brgyad bcu

2a1(mdo sna tshogs): @#//nang du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs so//byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po de yang nang du yang dag 'jog pa zhugs pa las/nang du yang dag 'jog 
2a2(mdo sna tshogs): langs te/dge slong gi 'khor dang/dge slong ma'i 'khor dang/dge bsnyen gyi 'khor dang/dge bsnyen ma'i 'khor dang/lha dang/klu dang/gnod sbyin dang/dri za dang/lha ma yin dang/
2a3(mdo sna tshogs): nam mkha' lding dang/mi 'am ci dang/lto 'phye chen po'i 'khor dag dang lhan cig tu stan bting ba la 'dug go/byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang snang ba thob pa/gzungs thob pa/ting nge 'dzin
2a4(mdo sna tshogs): thob pa/mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/tshig gzung bar 'os pa/tshul 'chos pa med pa/shes kyi khe dang chags sems dang bral ba/zang zing med par chos ston pa/chos zab mo la bzod
2a5(mdo sna tshogs): pa'i pha rol du son pa/mi 'jigs pa thob pa/bdud kyi las las yang dag par 'das pa/las kyi sgrib pa spangs pa/chos kyi rang bzhin la the tshom med pa thob pa/bskal pa grangs med par smon
2a6(mdo sna tshogs): lam shin du brtsams pa/bzhin 'dzum pa gsod por smra ba/khro gnyer med pa/tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis smra ba/sems zil gyis mi non pa/spobs brgyun mi 'chad pa/mnyam pa nyid
2a7(mdo sna tshogs): la bzod pa thob pa/'khor mtha' yas pa zil gyis gnon cing mi 'jigs pa thob pa/tshig gcig gis bskal pa bye ba tshang phyin pa ston pa la mkhas pa/chos thams cad la sgyu ma dang/smig rgyu
2a8(mdo sna tshogs): dang/chu zla dang/rmi lam dang/brag cha dang mtshungs par mos pa/shes pa mi 'jigs pa tshad med pa/sems can gyi sems kyi rgyu ba phra mo 'tshul dang spyod pa sna tshogs shes pa la mos pa/dge ba
2b1(mdo sna tshogs): rgya che ba/sems thogs pa med pa/lhag pa'i nga rgyal med cing bzod pa dang ldan pa/dge ba ji lta ba bzhin du brlabs che ba/sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bgod pa mtha' yas par smon lam rab tu gzung ba/
2b2(mdo sna tshogs): 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin rtag par mngon du gyur pa/sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la gsol ba 'debs pa la mkhas pa/lta ba tha dad pa dang/bag la nyal
2b3(mdo sna tshogs): ba dang|kun nas dkris pa'i nyon mongs pa rab tu zhi bar byed pa la mkhas pa/ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par rol pa brgya stong bsgrub pa la mkhas pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la sog
2b4(mdo sna tshogs): pa dang|'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang/spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang/'brug sgra dang/dge ba brgya stong gi me tog kun du rgyas pa'i blo dang/bsgrub pa mtha' yas pa'i blo can glog gis rab tu
2b5(mdo sna tshogs): brgyan pa'i sgra dbyangs dang/chags pa med pa'i mtha' dang ldan pa'i blo can dang/rnam par bsgrags pa'i rgyal po dang/'thun pa dang mi mthun pa mthong bar 'gyur ba dang/gser stug po bstsags pa'i
2b6(mdo sna tshogs): 'od gzi brjid kyi rgyal po dang/dpag tshad brgyar rnam par blta zhing 'gro ba dang/spobs pa brtsegs pa dang/ye shes phung po dang/mthong ba don yod dang/bzang skyong la sogs pa dang/skyes bu dam
2b7(mdo sna tshogs): pa brgyad po gang spos kyi glang po dang/rin chen mtha' yas mdzod dang/shes rab brtsegs pa dang/mchod pa bkod pa dang/seng ge rnam par sgrogs pa'i sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po dang/blo'i bkod pas
2b8(mdo sna tshogs): legs par brgyan pa la gnas pa dang/seng ge'i stabs kyis 'gro ba dang/spobs pa mtha' yas par bsgrub pa la 'jigs pa med pa dang/byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po
3a1(mdo sna tshogs): @#//la sogs pa dang/stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gang dag rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams dang/brgya byin dang/tshangs pa dang/dbang bsgyur dang/tshangs pa chen po dang/spu'i
3a2(mdo sna tshogs): rgyal po dang/gnod sbyin gyi bdag po dang/lha ma yin gyi bdag po dang/nam mkha' lding gi bdag po dang/mi 'am ci'i bdag po dang/lto 'phye chen po'i bdag po dang/dri za'i bdag po dang/de dag thams cad
3a3(mdo sna tshogs): bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste/bcom ldan 'das la me tog sil mas gtor nas 'khod par gyur to//de nas byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po nyin zhag bdun zas bcad de
3a4(mdo sna tshogs): 'chag cing 'greng la 'dug bzhin du glos ma phab par rmugs pa dang/gnyid med par mngon par brtson par gyur to//de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' mchod tu dga' ba'i rgyal pos 'di
3a5(mdo sna tshogs): skad ces gsol to//byang chub sems dpa' chos gang rdzogs par bgyis na/sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang spyod pa 'tshal bar 'gyur ba dang/sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa'i bka' la
3a6(mdo sna tshogs): 'jug par 'gyur ba dang/phyin ci log tu ston pa las mi ston par 'gyur ba dang/sgra ji lta ba bzhin du bden pa shes pa la rjes su 'jug par 'gyur ba dang/da ltar gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la sgrib pa
3a7(mdo sna tshogs): med par 'gyur ba dang/'di lta ste/sangs rgyas dang 'grogs pa 'thob cing mthong ba dang/chos kyis nges pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dang/'jig rten gyi chos la yang spyod la 'jig rten pas kyang mi gos
3a8(mdo sna tshogs): par 'gyur ba dang/snyoms par 'jug pa la gnas kyang de der skye bar mi 'gyur ba dang/mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos la spyod kyang yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar mi 'gyur ba dang/sangs rgyas
3b1(mdo sna tshogs): smon lam yongs su rdzogs par ma bgyis pa dang/nyan thos dang/rang sangs rgyas kyi chos la spyod kyang theg pa de dag gis nges par mi 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang/sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa la sems nag
3b2(mdo sna tshogs): nog ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang/khams sna tshogs la yang 'jug la thams cad kyi rjes su yang 'jug par 'gyur ba dang/zhu ba dang/spobs pa'i bsam pa la zil gyis non par mi 'gyur ba dang/sangs rgyas
3b3(mdo sna tshogs): kyi zhing gi bkod pa mtha' yas pa rab tu 'dzin cing shes rab ma lus par 'thob par 'gyur ba dang/sems can rnams yongs su smin par bgyid la sems can gyi 'du shes la yang mi gnas par 'gyur ba
3b4(mdo sna tshogs): dang/chos kyang ston la dmigs pa la yang mi gnas pa dang/mya ngan las 'das pa yang smra la nye bar zhi ba gang yang mi dmigs par 'gyur ba dang/byang chub kyi phyir yang spyod la mi gnas par yang 'gyur ba
3b5(mdo sna tshogs): dang/mchis pa dang/ma mchis pa yongs su spangs kyang rgya chen po la mos par 'gyur bar bgyid pa dag/bcom ldan 'das bdag ma 'tshal bzhin du mi zhu na/'on kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis stan du gsol
3b6(mdo sna tshogs): de nas byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal pos de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to//lha mi gnod sbyin dri za 'khor mang po//mtha' yas ji ltar mos bzhin tshogs lags pas//
3b7(mdo sna tshogs): byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa gang//'jig rten dag gi mgon po 'od mdzad pa//smra ba'i zla ba la ni zhu lags na//go rims bzhin du bdag la lung bstan gsol//byang chub spyod mchog yon
3b8(mdo sna tshogs): tan thos nas ni//skye bo phal chen 'dun gyur byang chub brtson//byang chub yon tan mchog la dad bskyed nas//yon tan kun mthar phyin la zhu lags na//grags pa mtha' yas dag gi sems mkhyen
4a1(mdo sna tshogs): @#//tam||rgyal ba ma gtogs dbang gzhan bdag la med//rgyal ba'i yon tan lha mi shin du skom//stobs bcu'i spyod pa rnam par phye ste gsungs//yon tan mchog spyod byang chub yon tan byung//
4a2(mdo sna tshogs): grags mdzes tshul chen khyod kyi mkhyen spyod gsungs//ji nas ye shes 'od zer 'phro bgyid cing//nag po'i rtsa lag dpung bcas 'joms bgyid la//ji nas stong gsum myur du g.yo bgyid pa//de 'dra'i byang 
4a3(mdo sna tshogs): chub spyod pa bde gshegs gsungs//ji nas mtshan gyi me tog rgyas 'gyur zhing//ji nas mtha' yas dbyangs ldan 'gyur ba dang//ji nas ri rab 'dra ba'i ting 'dzin 'gyur//de 'dra'i byang chub sems spyod pa shad 
4a4(mdo sna tshogs): du gsol//mnyam med mtshungs med g.yo med tshul 'chos med//nga bral dgra bcom dri gsum dri bral ba//dge spyod mchog ste mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis bstod//khyod la mi mchog dag gi spyod pa zhu//rtogs blo 
4a5(mdo sna tshogs): brtan po dran ldan me tog gsungs//'khrul med legs spyad spyod mnga' smra ba'i mchog/dri bsal skyes bzang khyu mchog phan mdzad pa//ci nas rgyal 'gyur de ltar bdag la gsungs//khyod las nyin mtshan 
4a6(mdo sna tshogs): dag tu 'di dag gis//mnyan nas byang chub spyod pa yang dag la//yid la byed pa gzhan med bde ba yis//spyod pa 'di la mchog tu spyod par 'gyur//ji nas ting 'dzin ldan zhing gzungs ldan dang//ji nas blo 
4a7(mdo sna tshogs): dang shes rab spobs ldan dang//phyogs mtha' yas par sangs rgyas mthong ba dang//tshul dang tshul min dri ba 'dri ba dang//ji ltar ye shes mtshungs med 'gyur ba dang//dge ba sgo brgya dag ni bsgrub pa dang//
4a8(mdo sna tshogs): 'chang ba la ni 'khrul pa med 'gyur ba//stobs bcu'i spyod pa khyod la zhu lags so//srid pa'i bde la chags te'ang mi zhu'o//yul gyis bsgyur slad du'ang mi zhu'o//rgyal ba'i bdud rtsi la ni bdag legs 'dun//
4b1(mdo sna tshogs): stobs bcu'i spyod pa bdag la myur du gsungs//de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcol ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal 
4b2(mdo sna tshogs): po legs so legs so//chos thams cad kyi tshul la nges par ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod de/byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin de dang ldan na yon tan de dag 'thob par 'gyur ro//gzhan yang pha rol du phyin 
4b3(mdo sna tshogs): pa brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su rdzogs par byed do//ting nge 'dzin stong phrag brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi 'thob par 'gyur ro//gzungs stong phrag brgyad bcu rtsa bzhI 'thob par 'gyur ro//sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa 
4b4(mdo sna tshogs): la 'jug pa mkhas pa yang rtogs par 'gyur ro//myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar yang 'gyur ro//mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyas po chos thams cad kyi 
4b5(mdo sna tshogs): tshul la nges par ston pa zhe bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin de gang zhe na/'di lta ste ji skad smras pa de bzhin du byed pa nyid do//ji ltar byas pa de bzhin du smra ba nyid do//lus ngag par byed do//ngag dag par byed do//sems 
4b6(mdo sna tshogs): dag par byed do//phan par 'dod pa nyid do//byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa nyid do//snying rje nyid mi spong pa'o//'dod pa dag la don du mi gnyer ba nyid do//chos don du gnyer ba nyid do//dad pa chud za bar mi byed 
4b7(mdo sna tshogs): pa'o//rang gis dam bcas pa kun du spyod pa nyid do//nges pa'i tshig la mkhas pa'o//sems can sgrol ba'o//cang shes kyi las can no//lus la mi bskam pa nyid do//sems rgyu ba med pa nyid do//sdug 
4b8(mdo sna tshogs): bsngal dang ldan pa rnams la tshim par byed pa nyid do//bde ba dang ldan pa rnams la gzed bstod pa'o//bag med pa rnams la 'doms pa'o//brtson pa rnams la 'chos pa'o//chos la 'gyod pa dag sel ba 
5a1(mdo sna tshogs): @#//nyid do//sems can gyi 'du shes la mi gnas pa'o//dngos po'i 'du shes kyis rtog pa med pa'o//'dzin pa yongs su gcod pa'o//mtshan ma rnam par 'jig pa nyid do//mnyam par bzhag 
5a2(mdo sna tshogs): pa la g.yo ba med pa'o//rtag tu ye shes tshol ba'o//'jig rten pa'i gtam rnam par spong pa nyid do//'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtam tshol ba nyid do//dran pa nyams pa med pa nyid do//chos rnams la brjod pa 
5a3(mdo sna tshogs): med pa nyid do//ji ltar bya ba bzhin du 'jug pa'o//spyod pa bsgrub pa'o//'jig rten shes pa nyid do//las la mngon par yid ches pa nyid do//ma dad pa yongs su spang pa nyid do//mos pa med pa nyid do//sangs rgyas 
5a4(mdo sna tshogs): yid la byed pa'o//'phel ba ston pa'o//bsod nams kyi rjes su yi rang ba nyid do//sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'debs pa nyid do//sbyin gnas la phyag 'tshal ba nyid do//bsngags pa brjod pa nyid do//nga 
5a5(mdo sna tshogs): rgyal med pa nyid do//dge ba'i rtsa bas ngoms pa med pa nyid do/sbyor bas rtag tu mngon par brtson pa'o//bsgrub pa mi spong zhing rdzogs par byed pa nyid do//rgyu rkyen gyi las bya ba la 'jig rten na rgya che ba'o//dam 
5a6(mdo sna tshogs): bcas pa mi 'dral ba'o//gzhi gcig tu mi 'jig pa nyid do//'di kho na bden no zhes mngon par zhen pa med pa'o//'dod pa'i khams la khyim mo zhes brjod pas mi 'jug pa'o//gzugs kyi khams la mngon par 
5a7(mdo sna tshogs): zhen pa med pa'o//gzugs med pa'i khams kyi rang bzhin ma yin pa'o//ji ltar mngon par 'du byed pa'i 'bras bu la mngon par yid ches pa nyid do//yo byad la bgo bsha' byed cing sems mnyam pa nyid do//
5a8(mdo sna tshogs): sems can thams cad la g.yos mi bsten pa nyid do//sangs rgyas rnams la mi slu ba nyid do//byang chub sems dpa' rnams la rnam par tho mi 'tsham pa'o//bstan pa la ngan du mi brjod pa nyid do//rigs 
5b1(mdo sna tshogs): pa dang ldan pa dang rigs pa dang ldan pa ma yin pa la zhe sdang med pa'o//pha rol gyi sde rnyed pa la mi gnas pa'o//bsam pa rdzogs par bya ba mi spong pa'o//nga rgyal spong ba'o//khong khro ba spong ba'o//gti mug yang dag 
5b2(mdo sna tshogs): par 'joms pa'o//rnyed pa la kun du mi spyod pa'o//ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa'o//shes kyi khe spong ba'o//ma rnyed pa la mi dga' ba med pa'o//rnyed pas khengs pa med pa'o//ci rnyed pa la bgo bsha'i dang 
5b3(mdo sna tshogs): tshul can nyid do//stsogs par mi byed pa nyid do//mi snyan par zer ba dang du len pa nyid do//tshig bsrung ba'o//blo gsal bar byed pa'o//rigs pa dang ldan pa la bskul ma 'debs pa'o//rigs pa dang ldanapa ma 
5b4(mdo sna tshogs): yin pa la mi ston pa'o//phyir zhing 'dri ba'o//nang du yang dag 'jog mi spong ba'o//dgon pa yongs su mi gtong ba'o//rtag tu sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa'o//stong pa nyid la mos pa'o//dngos pos yongs su 
5b5(mdo sna tshogs): tshim pa ma yin pa'o//phung po la mi gnas pa'o//khams rnams 'dul ba'o//skye mched la mi dmigs pa nyid do//yul la mi stong pa'o//phyin ci log spong ba'o//sems brtan por bsgrub pa'o//'phags pa'i gnas 
5b6(mdo sna tshogs): pa'o//sems la brkam chags med pa nyid do//sbyin gnas kyis thob pa nyid do//mngon par 'du byed pa shin tu sbyangs pa'o//sbyin pas rnam par smin pa mi len pa'o//tshul khrims kyis mi snyems pa nyid do//bzod 
5b7(mdo sna tshogs): pas rtogs pa med pa'o//brtson 'grus chud za ba med pa'o//bsam gtan gyis skye ba med pa'o//shes rab kyis chud za ba med pa'o/sa la 'jug pa'i pha rol du phyin pa mnyam pa nyid do//rang gi yon tan gyis 
5b8(mdo sna tshogs): snyems pa med pa nyid do//gzhan gyi yon tan la sun mi 'byin pa'o//'khor ba la mi gnas pa'o//mya ngan las 'das pa la mi dmigs pa nyid do//thar pa la dbang du gyur pa'o//mya ngan las 'dasapa la ma chags 
6a1(mdo sna tshogs): @#//pa'o||nges pa la gnas pa'o//bzhin 'dzum pa'o//khro gnyer dang bral ba nyid do//gsod por smra ba nyid do//'os pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa gsar bu dang /bar ma dang /rgan ra bas la bkur ste byed pa'o//
6a2(mdo sna tshogs): rnam par 'tshe ba med pa nyid do//rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa'o//zhi ba la bsngags pa brjod pa'o//tshogs pa la mngon par brtson pa'o//mdza' ba dang mi mdza' ba la sems mnyam pa nyid do//gzungs tshol ba'o//sems can 
6a3(mdo sna tshogs): rnams la ni ma la srid zhu che ba lta bu'o//'dzangs pa la ni pha la srid zhu che ba lta bu'o//bla ma rnams la ni mkhan po la srid zhu che ba lta bu'o/|byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ni sangs rgyas la gus pa lta bu'o//bsgrub pa 
6a4(mdo sna tshogs): rdzogs par byed pa nyid do//de bzhin gshegs pa la bkur sti byed pa'o//dge ba la mos pa nyid do//dkon mchog gsum la zhum pa med pas bkur sti byed pa'o//tha snyad la mi gnas par dang du len pa nyid do//
6a5(mdo sna tshogs): lus la mi blta ba nyid do//srog la lhag par chags pa med pa nyid do//'tsho ba dag par byed pa'o//bsod snyoms la rgyu ba dag brtson pa mi spong pa'o//tshogs pa'i gnas yongs su spong ba'o//khyim pa rnams la mi 
6a6(mdo sna tshogs): bstod pa'o//rab tu byung ba rnams kyi nang na 'du 'dzi la mi gnas pa'o//tshul 'tshos pa med pa nyid do//kha gsag med pa nyid do//snyan par smra ba nyid do//byang chub yang dag par len du 'jug pa nyid do//rang bzhin gyis 
6a7(mdo sna tshogs): zhum pa med pa nyid do//tshul bzhin la 'jug pa'o//phyir zhing sangs rgyas la bstod pa nyid do//chos la rab tu sems pa nyid do//dge 'dun la rtag tu rjes byed pa'o//shes pa dang ldan pa rnams la rtag tu mchod pa 
6a8(mdo sna tshogs): byed pa'o//'dzangs pa rnams la rtag tu bsten pa'o//bsam gtan pa rnams la rtag tu bsrung pa'o//rigs pa dang ldan pa rnams las rtag tu bskul ma 'debs pa'o//sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la rtag tu rton pa'o//chos rnams 
6b1(mdo sna tshogs): la rtag tu bsgom pa'o//bsod nams la rtag tu yid ches pa nyid do//sems can rnams la rtag tu yangs pa'o//dad pa dang ldan pa rnams la rtag tu byams pa'o//sdug bsngal dang ldan pa rnams sel ba'o//
6b2(mdo sna tshogs): spyod lam dag par byed pa'o//ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa'o//ngo tsha ba dang 'jigs pa ston pa'i tshul can no//spyod pa ngan pa spong ba nyid do//cho ga la bsten pa'o//spong ba la mngon du phyogs pa'o//
6b3(mdo sna tshogs): 'phags pa'i gnas pa tshol ba'o//dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bsgom pa'o//yang dag par spong ba bsten pa'o//dbang po rnams 'dzin pa'o//stobs rnams zil gyis mi non pa'o//byang chub kyi yan lag rnams
6b4(mdo sna tshogs): lhag par mthong ba'o//lam la phyin ci ma log pa nyid do//zhi gnas rgya che ba'o//lhag mthong la bskul ma 'debs pa'o//sems brjed nges pa med pa nyid do//chos la mngon par dga' ba'o//dmigs pa las
6b5(mdo sna tshogs): yang dag par 'das pa'o//mi gnas pa la mi skrag pa'o//dmigs pa med pa la bag med pa'i 'du shes dang bral ba'o//byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa kun du bsrung ba nyid do//sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa tshad med par byed
6b6(mdo sna tshogs): pa'o//mi mthun pa'i spyod pa la smod pa nyid do//sngon gyi mngon par 'du byed pa la yid byung ba'o//rang gi las yongs su spyod zhing 'dul ba ma yin pa speng pa'o//bstan pa sun mi 'byin pa'o/the tsom mi 'dzin
6b7(mdo sna tshogs): pa'o//dus su spyod pa nyid do//dus ma yin pa rnam par spong ba nyid do//'gro ba dang ldog pa la mkhas pa'o//tshod shes pa nyid do/yo byad kyis chog shes pa'o//mngon par shes pa rgya che ba'o//ting nge 'dzin khong du chud
6b8(mdo sna tshogs): pa'o//spyod pa'i bye brag can no//snying stobs rgya che ba'o//de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bstan pa'o//mi dmigs pas yongs su bzung ba'o//brtson pa dang ldan pa rnams tshim par byed pa'o//sangs rgyas kyi sras rnams
7a1(mdo sna tshogs): @#//kyis bsgom pa'o//byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nor yin no//sangs rgyas rnams kyi gnas pa'o//mkhas pa rnams kyi spyod pa'o//cang shes kyi 'gros kyi spyod yul ba'o//chos smra ba rnams kyi spyod 
7a2(mdo sna tshogs): yul lo//mos pa mang ba rnams la bskul ma 'debs pa'o//'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po mthong ba'i tshul can no//nor don du gnyer ba rnams kyi mdzod do//rnam par smin pa dang ldan pa rnams kyi zhing do//gdungs 
7a3(mdo sna tshogs): ba rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba'o//gzungs thob pa rnams kyi bskyed mos tshal lo//ting nge 'dzin thob pa rnams kyi rdzing ngo //chos dkar po dang ldan pa rnams kyi ma'o//gtam la mos pa rnams kyi gnas so//mtshan rnams 
7a4(mdo sna tshogs): kyi rgyu'o//dpe byad rnams rnam par 'byed pa'o//sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang dag pa'i gnas so//gzungs rab tu thob pa'o//bsgrub pa khong du chud pa'o//shin tu rigs par smra ba nyid do//bdud kyi yul las 'das pa'o//dpa' bo 
7a5(mdo sna tshogs): rnams kyi yul lo//nyon mongs pa 'joms pa'o//mi dge ba 'jil ba'o//smon lam dang ldan pa rnams kyi rgyan no//bdud kyis mi phyed pa'o//bstan pa zad mi shes pa'o//mu stegs can rnams kyis shes par dka' ba'o//'jig 
7a6(mdo sna tshogs): rten dang mi mtshungs pa'o//nyan thos kyi chos las 'das pa'o//rang byang chub kyis nges par ma byung ba'o//thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la yang dag par zhugs pa'o//sems can gyi 'gro ba la 'jug pa'o//yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin 
7a7(mdo sna tshogs): du bskul ma 'debs pa'o//bza' ba 'dod pa rnams dga' bar byed pa'o//btud pa 'dod pa rnams kyi ro bro ba'o//mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba rnams kyi snying po'o//mya ngan las 'das pa 'gro ba rnams kyi shing rta'o//pha rol du 
7a8(mdo sna tshogs): 'gro ba rnams kyi gru'o//rgal 'dod pa rnams kyi gzings so//snying rje can rnams kyi mar me'o//chos ston pa rnams kyi skar mnga'o//mi slu bar 'dod pa rnams kyi gnas so//sbyin par 'dod pa rnams kyi nor yin no//grol bar 
7b1(mdo sna tshogs): 'dod pa rnams kyi rigs pa'o//rtsed mo don du gnyer ba rnams dang bar byed pa'o//nyan pa'i bsam pa can rnams kyi rgya mtsho'o//ting nge 'dzin thob pa rnams kyi ri rab bo//mig la dga' ba rnams kyi dbang po'o//blta 'dod pa 
7b2(mdo sna tshogs): rnams kyi bkod pa'o//sems dang ldan pa rnams dga' ba'o//phyir mi ldog pa rnams kyi gnas so//mi skye ba'i bzod pa thob pa rnams kyi bsam pa'o//las dang po pa rnams kyi bsgom pa'o//skyes bu shes pa dang ldan pa 
7b3(mdo sna tshogs): rnams kyi rgyal mtshan no//zhi gnas la bkur sti byed pa rnams kyi byang chub po//bdag med par smra ba rnams kyi sred med kyi bu'o//thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam mo//ye shes dang rnam par grol ba rnams kyi skye ba 
7b4(mdo sna tshogs): mnyam pa nyid do//lha rnams kyis bsngags pa'o//klu rnams kyis brjed pa'o//mi rnams kyis mchod pa'o//slob pa rnams kyis ngo mtshar du byas pa'o//mi slob pa rnams kyis phyag byas pa'o//byang chub sems dpa' 
7b5(mdo sna tshogs): rnams kyis bstod pa'o//chos kyi rje rnams kyis bsgoms pa'o//dbang po sbas pa rnams kyi grong khyer ro//thabs mkhas pa rnams kyi tshul lo//brtson pa rnams kyi rnyed pa'o//the tsom rnams sel ba'o//yid gnyis 
7b6(mdo sna tshogs): gcod pa'o//nyon mongs pa rnams sel ba'o//byang chub sems dpa'i rnams kyi gzungs so//nad pa rnams kyi snan pa'o//phyin ci log pa rnams gso ba'o//zug rngu rnams 'byin pa'o//brtson par 'dod pa rnams yid 
7b7(mdo sna tshogs): la byed pa'o//sgrogs par 'dod pa rnams kyi mi 'jigs pa'o//smra bar 'dod pa rnams kyi so so yang dag par rig pa rgya che ba'o//rnam par 'phrul bar 'dod pa rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul lo//nyan 'dod pa rnams kyi 'gro 
7b8(mdo sna tshogs): ba'o//blta 'dod pa rnams kyi mig go/mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam mo//ngan song rnams spong ba'o//'dod pa dang /gzugs dang gzugs med pa dag las 'das pa'o//sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag rnam par bsgrub pa'o//
8a1(mdo sna tshogs): @#//rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin len pa'o//srid pa tham pa dag seng ge'i gdan la 'dug pa'o//chud za ba med par don du gnyer ba rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad do//skyo ba rnams dga' bar byed 
8a2(mdo sna tshogs): pa'o//ltung ba rnams 'degs pa'o//rtsom pa rnams brtan por byed pa'o//spyod pa'i khams rnam par bsgrub pa'o//snyom las byed pa dag yid la byed pa'o//theg pa gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi bka' yin no//'dzin pa 
8a3(mdo sna tshogs): thams cad spangs pa'o//thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'o//don dam pa smra ba rnams kyi sgo mtha' yas pa bsgrub pa rab tu thob pa'o//stong pa nyid smra ba rnams kyi chos chud mi za ba'o//smon lam gyi 
8a4(mdo sna tshogs): sgo'i shugs mthar phyin pa'o//mtshan ma med ma la mos pa rnams la brda sprod pa'o//mthong ba dang /btang snyoms la mos pa rnams kyi dus gsum mnyam pa nyid do//thams cad kyi rjes su song ba la thabs mkhas 
8a5(mdo sna tshogs): pa'o//byang chub yongs su ston pa'o//pha rol pos dpa' dgong du med pa'o//chos smra ba la ma 'khrul bar tshor ba nyid do//zang zing med par chos smra ba la yang dag par bsten pa'o//chos mnyan pa la g.yeng ba med 
8a6(mdo sna tshogs): pa'o//'khor la brnyas pa med pa'o//chos kyi sbyin pa la bar chad med pa'o//nges pa rnams kyi dri ba la ngo mtshar du byed pa'o//'gyod pa rnam par sel ba'o//sbyor ba la rgyun chad pa med pa'o//ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su mi gtong 
8a7(mdo sna tshogs): ba'o//'dzin pa la gnas pa rnams kyi rnam par grol ba'o//ma rungs ba rnams dul bar byed pa'o//nyon mongs pa rnams 'dor ba'o//mi gnas pa la spyod pa'o//rjes su dran pa 'dod pa rnams kyi dran pa'o//byang chub 
8a8(mdo sna tshogs): sems dpa' rnams slong bar byed pa'o//'khor bzhi la ston pa'o//ro bro ba rnams kyi nang na mngar ba'o//rnam par 'phrul bar 'dod pa rnams kyi sgra sgrogs pa'o//srid pa las ldog par 'dod pa rnams kyi sgo 'byed pa'o//mya ngan las 'das 
8b1(mdo sna tshogs): bar thar pa'o//lus bde ba'o//sems bde ba'o//mkhas pa rnams dga' ba'o//yi dam la brtan pa rnams mi gtong ba'o//de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan las mi ldog pa'o//dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyi 
8b2(mdo sna tshogs): gnas so//mi dge ba rnams nges par 'joms pa'o//'chal pa'i shes rab can rnams kyi bslab pa'o//rigs la gnas pa rnams kyi gnas so//slu ba med par mtshon pa'o//sangs rgyas kyi snang ba 
8b3(mdo sna tshogs): bsgrub pa'o//ye shes kyi phung po'i snang ba'o//sangs rgyas kyi zhing ston pa'o//dri ba bye ba snyed 'dri ba'o//chos dkar po dag la rtog pa'o//skyo ba'i blo can rnams kyi dmigs pa'o//shes rab chung ba rnams 
8b4(mdo sna tshogs): chud mi za ba'o//rig pa can rnams dga' bar 'gyur ba'o//smra 'dod pa rnams kyi spyod pa'i rgyu'o//chos ston pa rnams bsrung ba'o//rgyu thams cad yongs su shes pa'o//chos thams cad la thabs mkhas 
8b5(mdo sna tshogs): pa'o//rtog pa'i thabs grub pa'o//de kho na yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin mthong ba'o//bdag la brda sprod pa'o//gzhan dag yang dag par tshim par byed pa'o//dra ba gcod pa'o//ma rig pa sel ba'o//
8b6(mdo sna tshogs): phung po rnams yongs su shes pa'o//rnam par shes pa yongs su shes pa'o//ming dang gzugs sdud pa'o//skye mched drug mthong ba'o//reg pa yongs su shes pa'o/tshor ba shes pa'o//sred pa rab tu 
8b7(mdo sna tshogs): zhi bar byed pa'o//nye bar len pa bor ba'o//srid pa chad pa'o//skye ba choms pa'o//rga shi las 'das pa'o//sdug bsngal shin tu sbyangs pa'o//bde ba la kun du rangs pa'o//sdug bsngal dang yid mi 
8b8(mdo sna tshogs): bde ba rnam par sel ba'o//grub pa rnams gnas par spyod pa'o//dpyod pa rnams tshim par byed pa'o//snang ba skyon med pa'o//chos kyis rjes su bsgrags pa'o//skyes bu grags pa can rnams kyi mthu 
9a1(mdo sna tshogs): @#//rtsal lo//'byung po dri ma can rnams 'khru ba'o//'jig tshogs la blta ba rnams ngas par 'joms pa'o//thos pa kun du 'dzin pa'o//chos rnams kun du 'dzin pa'o//byang chub 'khrul ba med pa nyid 
9a2(mdo sna tshogs): do||dge ba thams cad la 'jug pa mi ldog pa'o//dge ba phal cher bsags pa'o//blo bsgrub pa'i gzhi'o//brtson pa dang ldan pa rnams kyi chos kyi tshul lo//'phags pa'i dge 'dun 'phel bar byed pa'o//phas 
9a3(mdo sna tshogs): kyi rgol ba rnams tshar gcod pa'o//chos smra ba rnams la legs so zhes brjod pa'o//byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa'o//rtsed mo 'dod pa rnams kyi zla ba'o//las kyi mtha' don du gnyer ba rnams 
9a4(mdo sna tshogs): kyi nyi ma'o//slob par 'dod pa rnams kyi bstan chos so//phu dung dang bcas pa rnams kyi rgyal po'o//mkhas pa rnams kyi 'dren pa'o//chos dkar po rnams kyi sa bon no//rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu'i bdud 
9a5(mdo sna tshogs): rtsi'o||skye ba dran pa'i gzhi'o//skye ba rab tu thob pa'o//byis pa'i chos rnams la smod pa'o//de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi yon tan yang dag pa'o//ston pa dang 'dzin pa rnam par smin pa mtha' yas pa'o//
9a6(mdo sna tshogs): thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi gnas so//ston pa na bde 'gro thob par 'gyur ba'o//yi ger 'dri ba na 'jigs pa thams cad spong ba'o//rgal nas phyir ldog pa med pa'o//rtogs pa brjod pa'i gnas so//
9a7(mdo sna tshogs): 'jig rten thams cad kyi bstan pa mnos pa'o//'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa'o//da ltar gyi sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi gter ro//ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs 
9a8(mdo sna tshogs): pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o//yang dag pa'i ye shes 'khrugs pa med pa myur du 'thob par 'gyur ba'o//sangs rgyas kyi phyag las byung ba'i phyag rgya'o//sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yongs su dri 
9b1(mdo sna tshogs): par 'dun pa la ngoms pa med pa'o//khong khro ba'i rnam par rig pa rab tu zhi ba'o//thabs mkhas pa rab tu thob pa'o//sa'i khams bsgom pa'o//chu'i khams la 'jug pa'o//me'i khams la snyoms par 
9b2(mdo sna tshogs): 'jug pa'o//rlung gi khams gnas par byed pa'o//nam mkha'i khams rnam par thar pa bsgrub pa'o//shes pa'i khams ston par byed pa'o//'dus byas la yid byung ba'o//bag la nyal zlog pa'o//khong khro 
9b3(mdo sna tshogs): ba sel ba'o//btang snyoms su 'dor ba'o//rang gi gnas pa la mkhas pa'o//gzhan gyi gnas pa la mkhas pa'o//brjod pa 'dod pa rnams kyi yi ge'o//bsgrub pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa med pa'o//
9b4(mdo sna tshogs): ngar 'dzin pa spong ba'o//nga yir 'dzin pa 'dor ba'o//mos pa bzlog pa'i gnas so//sems 'jig pa dang bcas pa'o//sems khyi dang mtshungs pas bsten pa'o//rgya che ba la 'jug pa'o//phra ba rtogs par 
9b5(mdo sna tshogs): byed pa'o//dal ba rnams kyi grib ma'o//chu bo las sgrol ba'o//phas kyi rgol ba rnams kyis mi phyed pa'o//des pa rnams kyi khar ba'o//dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsnyen bkur byed pa'o//rmugs pa dang gnyid 
9b6(mdo sna tshogs): rnams spong ba'o//rgod pa las 'das pa'o//the tsom spong ba'o//'dod pa la 'dun pa sel ba'o//le lo yongs su spong ba'o//bdag tu mi dmigs pa'o//sems can du mi ston pa'o//srog tu mi gnas pa'o//
9b7(mdo sna tshogs): chos la brjed ngas pa med pa'o//phyin ci log med pa'i gtam smra ba'o//rigs par smras pa'o//mngon par 'du byed pa la legs par bsams pa'o//cang shes kyi ngo bo'o//zhum pa med pa'i ngo bo'o//sbyin pa 
9b8(mdo sna tshogs): dang ye shes la mos pa nyid do//'khor gyi nang du zhum pa med par 'gro ba nyid do//gzhan la mi smod pa nyid do//rang gi yon tan mi brjod pa'o//byang chub kyi phyir rtag tu gnas pa'o//sbyor bar brtsams pa'o//
10a1(mdo sna tshogs): @#//phyogs 'ga' la yun ring du mi gnas pa'o//yongs su 'dzin pa spong ba'o//bkra shis par yang dag par spyod pa'o//lus kyi ngo bo ma yin pa'o//sems zhum pa med pa nyid do//gnas pa la mkhas 
10a2(mdo sna tshogs): pa'o||rjes su 'gro ba bsgom pa'o//mi g.yo zhing nga rgyal med pa'o//rnam par grol ba tshol ba'o//the tsom nges par byed pa'o//tshangs pa'i gnas pa bskyed pa'o//byams pa'i sems mnyam pa nyid do//snying rjes rjes 
10a3(mdo sna tshogs): su 'dzin pa nyid do//dga' bas rang la dga' bar nyams su myong ba nyid do//btang snyoms pa na rjes su chags pa dang /khong khro ba sel ba'o//tshul khrims kyis gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'o//ting nge 'dzin bsgrub pa la 
10a4(mdo sna tshogs): 'jug pa'o//chos thams cad la shes rab kyis rnam par grol bar 'jug pa'o//yi ge bsgrub pa khong du chud pa'o//nges pa'i tshig la mkhas pa'o//brjod pa rtogs pa'o//sgra la 'jug pa'o//mkhas pa'i ngo bo 
10a5(mdo sna tshogs): don du gnyer ba nyid do//'dod pa med par chos kyi sbyin pa rab tu sgrogs pa nyid do//blo gcig tu nges pa la mngon par dga' ba med pa'o//tshul gcig pa la yongs su skyo ba med pa'o//byang chub la blang dor med pa'o//
10a6(mdo sna tshogs): chos thams cad chud za ba med pa'o//ji lta ba bzhin yongs su ston pa'o//sems can thams cad la slu ba med pa nyid do//smon lam brtan po yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o//nyin mtshan du sbyor ba la rgyun chad pa 
10a7(mdo sna tshogs): med pa'o//byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa'o//sems can gyi khams la 'jug pa'o//thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bsgrub pa ste/mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po 'di ni chos thams cad kyi tshul la nges par 
10a8(mdo sna tshogs): ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to//de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to//spyod pa dag byed 'phags pa rnams kyi lam//rjes su 'thun pa'i tshul yin sems 
10b1(mdo sna tshogs): sbyangs pa//spobs pa'i snying po byang chub yan lag tshul//ting 'dzin 'di ni bde bar gshegs pa'i nor//bdud 'dul dri bral kho nas khro ba spongs//srid pa'i sred pa gcod byed shes rab dang //snyan dang 
10b2(mdo sna tshogs): grags pa'i yon tan legs 'byor cing //khams gsum dag las nges 'byung mthar yang phyin//ye shes sa yin dge ba'i lam yang yin//'phags pa'i rigs yin bdud rnams phung byed pa//srid 
10b3(mdo sna tshogs): las thar byed bde bar gshegs pas bstod//ting 'dzin 'di ni bden bar gshegs pa'i nor/shin tu mnyam 'jug tshul ni bye ba'i sgo//rjes su rtogs byed tshim byed gcod byed cing //sdug bsngal bcom 
10b4(mdo sna tshogs): pa bde ba'i rjes 'jug pa//ting 'dzin 'di ni bdag shegs spyod pa yin//byang chub yan lag me tog dran rtogs byed//ngo tsha shes par legs gnas dge ba bsdus//byang chub yan lag phreng ba bde 
10b5(mdo sna tshogs): gshegs dgyes//ting 'dzin mchog de 'di ni gsungs pa yin//byang chub yan dag phreng ba rnam thar pa//rab tu skye byed zhing gi pha mthar phyin//zla ba'i 'od byed snang byed srid gsum 'das//chos 
10b6(mdo sna tshogs): mchog 'di kun zla bas bstod pa yin//sems g.yengs tshul 'chos shes khe rnyed pa dag/spangs nas dgon par bsten par 'gyur bya zhing //sbyor ba rnam gsum dag par 'gyur bya na//ting nge 'dzin 'di 
10b7(mdo sna tshogs): yang dag bsgrub par gyis//pha rol 'ching dang g.yo dang shes khe'i rgyu//spangs nas rang gi yon tan mi brjod par//chos gos gsum dang bsod snyoms spyod par shog/'di la sbyor gyur stsogs 'jog 
10b8(mdo sna tshogs): byed ma gyur//'phags pa bged pa'i ngang tshul ldan bya zhing //gal te ting 'dzin myur thob 'dod na ni//mkhas pas rtag tu dri ba brtsam bar gyis//dris nas yang dag bsgrub la'ang gnas par gyis//tshogs 
11a1(mdo sna tshogs): la thag ring zhi gnas dgar 'gyur dang //'gro kun la ni mdza' bas snyan bya zhing //tshul 'chos gzhi yi grags pa gzhir btad na//ting 'dzin zhi ba 'di ni btsal bar gyis//ngo tsha shes gos 
11a2(mdo sna tshogs): dben pa'i ro yi zas//bsam gtan mal cha stan dang dben pa'i khyim//bdag med rtogs la rtag tu dga' byed na//mkhas pa gzhan gyi bde la 'dod mi 'gyur//gal te ting 'dzin 'di myur thob 'dod na//
11a3(mdo sna tshogs): khros pas smras na gzhan la bzod pa dang //nga rgyal bskyed mi bya zhing nga bral bya//las kyi rnam par smin la'ang mngon dang gyis//ngan song lam dang dmigs la mi bsten cing //'phags pa'i 'gro ba stong la'ang 
11a4(mdo sna tshogs): mi bsten par//nyin mtshan brtson 'grus stobs la brtsam bya na//tshul gzhan min pa'i ting 'dzin 'di thob bya//mtha' gnyis yid 'ong ma yin lam spangs pa//yang dag tshul 'di lam ni mnyam 
11a5(mdo sna tshogs): pa ste//ma byas skye med chos ni sus mthong ba//bsgrub pa 'di la sangs rgyas dgyes par 'gyur//mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po 'di ni chos thams cad kyi tshul nges par ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 
11a6(mdo sna tshogs): ces bya ste/de thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sa ni chos thams cad phyin ci ma log pa nyid du rtogs so//chos thams cad mi gnas par rtogs so//chos thams can skye ba med par rtogs so//sangs rgyas 
11a7(mdo sna tshogs): kyi chos thams cad byas pa med par rtogs so//chos tham sa cad gsog tu rtogs so//chos thams cang gsob tu rtogs so//chos thamasacad snying po med par rtogs so//gzhan gyis zil gyis mi non 
11a8(mdo sna tshogs): to//'gro ba lnga las rgal to//bdud rlag par byed do//sems can thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro//mkhas pa rnams kyis mchod par bya ba yin no//chos nyid thams cad mthong ngo //zla ba ltar lhang 
11b1(mdo sna tshogs): der snang ngo //sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rgyu ba rab tu shes so//bsam pa dag pa rnams la bskul mi 'debs pa yin no//stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad shes 
11b2(mdo sna tshogs): pa yin no//spyod pa'i sa rjes su thob bo//bdag med pa nyid la 'jug go/nges par 'byung bar bya ba'i khams rab tu shes so//sems can thams cad gyi mngon pa'i nga rgyal med pa'i sa rjes su thob po//
11b3(mdo sna tshogs): sgrib pa las 'das so//ming dang gzugs kyi rang bzhin rab tu shes so//nges pa'i tshig gi sgo nas sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan pa rjes su rtogs so//mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis rab tu thob bo//
11b4(mdo sna tshogs): rnyed pa dang ma rnyed pas gtugs pa las 'das so//'jig rten na gos pa med pa nyid thob bo//sems can rnams kyi gnas yin no//mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgo 'byed do//sbyin pa po yin no//'chi ba med 
11b5(mdo sna tshogs): par ston pa yin no//mya ngan las 'angs pa khong du chud pa yin no//sems can rnams kyi gdung ba sel to//sems can rnams kyi the tshom gcod pa yin no//dbang po drug po dag gis mi gos pa yin no//
11b6(mdo sna tshogs): yi ge'i sgo bcu drug la 'jug pa'i gzungs thob bo//yi ge bcu drug 'thob pa gang zhe na/a zhes bya ba dang /ra zhes bya ba dang /ba zhes bya ba dang /tsa zhes bya ba dang /na zhes bya ba dang /da zhes bya ba dang /sa
